files.name: motion-prompt-116.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Duotone" (デュオトーン), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #116

What it is: Show the image in two colours, one for darks and one for lights
What the sample shows: The colours of the same landscape are replaced by a range between just two colours: indigo in the darks and pink in the lights.
Spec:
- Scene 3: a bust on the left (head centre x 140, y 82, radius 28 px) and hills, a house, trees and the sun (x 432, y 54, radius 15 px) on the right. 
- Two colours: #1F2A5C for the dark end, #FF9FB2 for the light end
- Conversion: from each colour’s luminance L, t = ((L − 70) / 180)^2.4, and the two colours are mixed by t (this spreads the light tones apart)
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: To unify posters, music artwork or social images in brand colours.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/116.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
